facts.text: During the last ice age, the Michigan tongue glacier carved the land that now hosts Delavan, pushing a lobe southwest into Walworth County.
Delavan welcomed the Olympic Circus in 1847, becoming the first Wisconsin town to host America’s largest traveling show before statehood.
The town of Delavan was officially formed on January 2, 1838, after Walworth County was divided by the territorial legislature.
Delavan Lake draws thousands of visitors each year, making the city a key spot for water‑sports enthusiasts near Lake Geneva.
Both the Delavan Historic District and the nearby Delavan Hall of Fame are listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
Archaeologists trace human presence in Delavan back to 1000 BCE, with Woodland‑culture mound builders settling the lake area by 1000 CE.
